Work materials and tools｜Orders, receiving and shipping documentation, location labels, inventory records and scanning systems; whether powered equipment is used depends on the job and the corresponding training authorization.

Verification and responsibility｜Check labels, units, quantities and status and keep the receipt and issue discrepancies. Report damage or stock-record mismatches under organizational rules; inventory changes, scrapping and shipment approval have separate responsibility.
